misc: Appreciates the thoughtful course designs of Kosti Kuronen who passed away in 2024
biography: Ofri represents the esteemed golfing tradition of Golf Pirkkala within the storied chronicles of the Hector Trophée. Residing in the vibrant city of Tampere, Finland, he brings a deeply thoughtful and architectural appreciation to the links, frequently expressing his profound admiration for the clever course designs crafted by the late Kosti Kuronen, who passed away in 2024. Away from the competitive pressure of tournament play, Ofri approaches every layout with the eye of a connoisseur, studying the subtle contours and strategic nuances of the terrain.

Throughout his journey in this prestigious multi-day championship, Ofri has registered four appearances as an active competitor on the fairways. While neither the coveted team Hector Trophée nor the individual Victor Trophy has yet been added to his personal trophy collection, his steadfast participation and refined appreciation for golf course architecture ensure that he remains a fascinating and respected presence within the ongoing narrative of the tournament.
